geometry_and_mapping_policy.coordinates: Owned finite FP32 encoder tensor derived from checked FP64 source/generated coordinates; bind both typed hashes and quantization error
geometry_and_mapping_policy.cyp_az_geometry: 1927 original SDF3D transports plus178 already closed ready native-coordinate candidates; restore saved FP64/F32, no new generation or retry

geometry_and_mapping_policy.source_rows: Preserve all source-native rows and explicit/isotope H; no canonical reordering or source conformer mutation

metric_policy.candidate_vs_supervision: Rank all source-defined candidates only when every candidate is supervised; unknown is not a negative
metric_policy.current_evaluator_runtime_role: train_inner_validation; final outer-test file adapter/role is later implementation work, not already verified by this artifact
metric_policy.graph_metrics: Per-task observed-label MAE/RMSE after FP64 inverse affine into original source label units; sum errors and divide by label count, never average batch means or incompatible units
metric_policy.score_and_membership_binding: Actual model score tensor/order, native IDs, label masks, record membership and current trained model/readout state hashes; caller score summaries are not accepted
metric_policy.som_denominator: Eligible fully supervised molecule-task instances with at least one positive; hit if any source-positive appears in top-k
metric_policy.som_evaluation_unit: One source record molecule by its eligible task/isoform; graph-local native source IDs, never pooled atom accuracy

optimization_policy.all_unknown_training_record_policy: Keep in source/split/embargo inventory and unknown report; exclude from optimizer batches by train-only mask recipe common to all variants
optimization_policy.batch_order: Fixed train-only order/permutation artifact, paired across conditions/readout seeds within rotation
optimization_policy.checkpoint_and_resume: Bind config/split/normalizer/initial actual encoder/order/cursor/complete AdamW moments/Torch RNG; use existing strict trainer checkpoint semantics
optimization_policy.graph_normalization: Train-split-only observed-label per-task mean and population standard deviation; finite zero variance uses scale1; no train labels gives unavailable normalizer/task report, never fit on validation/test
optimization_policy.selection: Final fixed update endpoint only; no early stopping or condition-specific extension
optimization_policy.task_weights: 1.0 for every configured output task; denominator is sum of all fixed task weights even if a task is missing in the batch
optimization_policy.total_updates_rule: 20 times the fixed number of retained training batches; each epoch visits each geometry-ready record with at least one observed supervised label once; final smaller batch retained
optimization_policy.tracking: Functional W&B with explicit commit and closed persistent history; retained offline runs are allowed with declared later sync method

readout_policy.complement_operation: Raw H0 mean pool, one Linear with bias, no activation
readout_policy.complement_scope: Graph regression datasets, auxiliary report; not separately selected per variant
readout_policy.graph_operation: per-native-atom Linear64/ReLU, mean pool over all native input rows, output Linear with bias
readout_policy.initializer: common.Linear Xavier uniform, zero bias; common readout seed0 across conditions

statistics_limitations: Only three independent pretraining seeds; folds/readout cells are dependent within-seed aggregation
Two-sided exact sign-flip minimum p=0.25; alpha0.05 significance impossible even before Holm
95% percentile bootstrap from three seeds has fragile coverage; report effects and this limitation
Holm is per-endpoint four-comparison family control, not a global35-task/32-endpoint FWER claim
